name: @borjie/privacy-router
description: Privacy-aware AI routing (LP-15 / PO-17). Routes inference requests by data-sensitivity tier: RESTRICTED -> local/deny, CONFIDENTIAL -> cloud + mandatory PII strip, INTERNAL/PUBLIC -> cloud. YAML-driven policy (BOT Act / PDPA). Wire-agnostic pure functions; PII stripping + local-endpoint health are injected ports. Ported from LITFIN security/privacy-router.ts.
